title: Lancaster Go-Around Practice with Mike | Cockpit & Wing Views
description: Join Mike and me for a relaxed flight over Lancaster as we practice several go-arounds and put some air over the plane to help dry it out after a wash.  The video features both cockpit and wing views, along with plenty of local scenery from the air. '74 Piper Warrior

title: Flying the RNAV 06 Approach into Lancaster (KLKR) | Piper Warrior
description: Flying the RNAV 06 instrument approach into Lancaster County–McWhirter Field (KLKR) while completing approaches for IFR currency. This flight took place on April 26, 2026, in Mike Morgan’s Piper Warrior PA-28-151. The cellphone footage was recorded on the spur of the moment and offers a look at a real-world practice instrument approach.

title: Quick Partial-Flap Landing at KLKR | Piper Comanche 260TC
description: Cockpit view of a partial-flap landing at Lancaster County–McWhirter Field (KLKR) on July 17, 2025, in a 1971 Piper Comanche 260TC.

title: Beating the Rain: Power-Off Landing at KLKR | Piper Warrior
description: A line of heavy rain was moving toward Lancaster County–McWhirter Field (KLKR), so the traffic pattern was shortened for a power-off landing in the Piper Warrior. The airplane glided through the base leg and a short final while the approaching rain line remained visible about a mile away.

title: Quick Steep Turn from the Cockpit | Viewer Request
description: A quick cockpit view of a steep turn, showing the horizon rotate as the airplane banks through the maneuver before returning to level flight. The video was recorded with a GoPro and edited on an iPad.

title: 360° Piper Comanche 260TC Landings | Move the Camera!
description: Interactive 360-degree cockpit footage of landing practice in a 1971 Piper Comanche PA-24-260TC. Viewers can drag the image, use arrow keys, or move a phone in the YouTube app to look around the cockpit during the landings.

title: AIRSPEED! Autopilot Interrupts the Stall Maneuver | 360° Piper Warrior
description: A 360-degree cockpit clip from a 1974 Piper PA-28-151 Warrior in which the autopilot interrupted a stall maneuver as the airspeed warning sounded. The video offers a movable view around the cockpit and a reminder to keep watching the airspeed.

title: KAFP (Anson County) to KLKR (Lancaster County): Dusk RNAV 24 Approach | Comanche 260TC Telemetry
description: A dusk flight from Anson County Airport (KAFP) in North Carolina to Lancaster County–McWhirter Field (KLKR) in South Carolina after a fuel stop. The 1971 Piper Comanche PA-24-260TC encountered a 10–15-knot headwind before flying the RNAV 24 approach into Lancaster; the on-screen gauges and telemetry are based on GPS data.

title: Flying into Treasure Cay, Bahamas | Scenic Abaco Arrival and Landing
description: A scenic flight over the waters and islands of Abaco while arriving at Treasure Cay in the Bahamas. Moisture on the camera lens affected parts of the footage. During the approach, another airplane was positioned near the far end of the runway, and the pilots communicated and coordinated by radio before landing.

title: Every Pilot Should Fly the Exumas | Departing Little Farmer’s Cay
description: A flight departing Little Farmer’s Cay Airport (MYE3) in the Exuma Cays on May 6, 2024. Cockpit views show the turquoise water, small islands, and scenery that make flying in the Bahamas memorable. The aircraft is a 1974 Piper PA-28-151 Warrior.

title: DME Arc to the ILS at Ocala (KOCF) | X-Plane 12 Piper Arrow
description: An X-Plane 12 flight-simulator demonstration created for a friend working on instrument training. The video uses a Piper Arrow to fly a DME arc leading into an ILS approach at Ocala International Airport (KOCF) in Florida and is intended as a simulator demonstration rather than a substitute for current charts or flight instruction.
